# Sean's Workspace

> A long-lived, surface/device/LLM-agnostic personal operating environment for design,
> engineering, product, data, and game work. It is simultaneously a git repository (the
> source of truth), an Obsidian vault, and an agent workspace. Any capable model — not just
> one vendor's — can enter, orient, and work here by following the universal contract below.
> Nothing here depends on Google Drive, a vendor-specific file bridge, or a specific assistant.

How to work here:

- Resolve the workspace root as the directory containing `AGENTS.md`. The git checkout is the
  source of truth — read and write plain files; commit reviewable diffs.
- On a **new session**, emit `python3 09-tools/session-status.py` (notices + all
  projects + pending). Continuations skip it. That is how every LLM — not only Claude —
  reminds Sean of open work and what needs improvement.
- Route a request: pipe it to `ws route --stdin` or run `python3 09-tools/skill-loadset.py "…"`.
  Never-ingest rules: AGENTS.md → Canonical read order + Skill loading precedence.
- To answer a request: match it to skills (via `triggers`/`description`), then load the skill plus
  its `load_chains` ancestors in order (foundation → hub → spoke). See AGENTS.md for the algorithm.
- **Multi-agent continuity:** this is one unified contract for *every* agent (not just Claude/Cursor/
  Perplexity). On entry, read the active project's `SESSION-STATE.md` **Live handoff** block to pick up
  exactly where the last agent left off; on handoff/pause/end, update it + write an attributed
  `06-context/sessions/<id>.md` fragment. A baton stays under 12 KB: older history moves word for word
  to `history/` beside it (`09-tools/validate-batons.py`); search all tiers with `09-tools/project-recall.py`
  before saying there's no record. Scaled jobs use a living spec + `09-tools/intent-run.py` (see AGENTS.md →
  Multi-agent continuity). A new agent needs no adapter.
- Before editing the workspace, consult the routing map and the contribution framework
  ([01-frameworks/08-workspace-contribution-framework.md](01-frameworks/08-workspace-contribution-framework.md)).
- **Externalize everything.** Keep nothing durable in your own private/internal memory — every
  learning, decision, project note, and asset routes to a workspace layer (or the platform `Projects`
  dir for actual repos/working files) per the routing map. This is an AGENTS.md Core rule; the only
  thing any agent keeps internally is a pointer back here.
- **Adapters** are thin, optional layers over AGENTS.md. A new tool needs no adapter to work at full
  fidelity; it just executes the AGENTS.md contract. Codex reads AGENTS.md natively, plus the
  `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` beacon and `codex-hooks.json`. Do not symlink AGENTS.md onto vendor filenames.

## Start here (read in order)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the universal agent contract — folder semantics, read order, the skill
  loading-precedence algorithm, and the bootstrap-on-a-checkout protocol.
- [trigger-routes-digest.md](02-shared-references/trigger-routes-digest.md): only when you can't run
  python; otherwise route with `ws route` or `skill-loadset.py` as above.
- [workspace-ontology.md](02-shared-references/workspace-ontology.md): vocabulary + the
  "where does this belong?" routing map. Read before writing anything.

## Contracts + specs
- [skill-frontmatter.md](02-shared-references/skill-frontmatter.md): the SKILL.md frontmatter v2 spec.
- [skills.registry.schema.json](03-skills/skills.registry.schema.json): JSON Schema for the registry.
- [epistemic-standards.md](02-shared-references/epistemic-standards.md): reasoning standards.
- [artifact-standards.md](02-shared-references/artifact-standards.md): output standards.

## Per-tool adapters (thin layers over AGENTS.md; optional)
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code / Desktop
- [CURSOR.md](CURSOR.md): Cursor
- [PERPLEXITY.md](PERPLEXITY.md): Perplexity
- [GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md): Gemini CLI
- [WARP.md](WARP.md): Warp
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): Copilot Chat
- [web-session.md](00-bootstrap/adapters/web-session.md): ChatGPT / Grok.com

## Generate / validate
- [build-registry.py](09-tools/build-registry.py): regenerate the skill registry from frontmatter (stdlib-only).
- [skill-loadset.py](09-tools/skill-loadset.py): compute the AGENTS.md load set (`python3 09-tools/skill-loadset.py "…"`).
- [close-out-dispatch.py](09-tools/close-out-dispatch.py): `--from-prompt "…" --run` runs the named L3 after
  produce (SKIP ≠ verified); `--check` confirms every command hub has a named detector.
- [validate-layer0-schema.py](09-tools/validate-layer0-schema.py): `--check` refuses malformed Layer 0 JSON.
- [check-secrets.py](09-tools/check-secrets.py): known secret shapes on tracked files.
